paragraph: [The Executive approved Angola's National Cybersecurity Strategy in 2025](<https://pti.ao/proposta-de-lei-da-ciberseguranca-entra-na-fase-de-analise-detalhada/>). In the last twelve months, [Lei n.º 9/26 of 28 September 2026 set up a National Cybersecurity Centre, with CERT.ao as its operational arm](<https://pti.ao/nova-lei-da-ciberseguranca-impoe-registo-e-notificacao-de-incidentes-a-operadores/>). [It requires operators of critical infrastructure and essential services to register with the Centre within 180 days](<https://pti.ao/nova-lei-da-ciberseguranca-impoe-registo-e-notificacao-de-incidentes-a-operadores/>). It also requires them to notify significant incidents to CERT.ao, with deadlines to be set by separate instrument. No incident handled or public alert issued by the national body has been found since October 2023. Establishing would need the national body to have handled a cyber incident or issued a public alert in the past three years.

[Burundi's Council of Ministers adopted a National Cybersecurity Strategy on 14 October 2026](<https://www.wearetech.africa/fr/fils/actualites/tech/burundi-une-strategie-nationale-pour-renforcer-les-capacites-de-cybersecurite>). [The Prime Minister's office records the same adoption in its communique of the meeting](<https://primature.gov.bi/communique-de-presse-n-13-2026-de-la-reunion-du-conseil-des-ministres-du-14-octobre-2026-le-numerique-la-securite-alimentaire-lenergie-et-la-transformation-agricole-au-coeur-du-conse/>). In the last twelve months the strategy is new: [the digital master plan reported in March 2026 that Burundi had no computer incident response team](<https://communityvoice.bi/burundi-embarks-on-a-full-digitalization-journey/>). No incident handled or public alert issued by the national body has been found since October 2023. No designation of critical information infrastructure has been found. Establishing would need the national body to have handled a cyber incident or issued a public alert in the past three years.

[In October 2021 a decree's annexed policy said Benin had adopted its national digital security strategy](<https://sgg.gouv.bj/doc/decret-2021-550/download>). [ASIN's director general says ASIN sets cybersecurity policies and runs an alert and incident response centre](<https://www.lanation.bj/numerique/marc-andre-loko-apres-le-lancement-du-rapport-sur-les-vulnerabilites-du-cyberspace-beninois-nous-disposons-aujourdhui-dun-dispositif-solide>). [ASIN presented Benin's first national report on cybersecurity vulnerabilities and incidents, covering 2021 to 2024](<https://techafricanews.com/2025/07/03/benin-releases-first-national-cybersecurity-report-highlighting-rising-threats>). In the last twelve months, [in November 2026 the digital minister cited the recent creation of a National Agency for Cybersecurity and Resilience](<https://beninwebtv.bj/en/cyber-africa-forum-2026-benin-prioritizes-digital-trust-and-sovereignty/>). No incident handled or public alert issued by the national body has been found since October 2023. Establishing would need the national body to have handled a cyber incident or issued a public alert in the past three years.

In April 2025 the government [put the security operations centre and response team of ANSSI, the national information systems security agency, into service](<https://burkina24.com/2025/04/29/cybercriminalite-les-directeurs-generaux-des-structures-publiques-de-letat-sensibilises-sur-la-problematique/>). Its director-general says ANSSI [treated 79 major alerts in the first half of 2025](<https://www.wearetech.africa/fr/fils/actualites/tech/cybersecurite-le-niger-sollicite-l-experience-du-burkina-faso-pour-son-soc-national>). In the last twelve months, [the Council of Ministers appointed its director-general on 16 April 2026](<https://burkina24.com/2026/04/16/compte-rendu-du-conseil-des-ministres-du-jeudi-16-avril-2026/>). No designation of critical information infrastructure or duty on operators to report incidents has been found. No figures after June 2025 have been found. Operating would need the country to designate its critical information infrastructure, or to bind the operators of critical systems to report incidents to the national body.

[BOCRA's 2025 annual report says the national CSIRT sits within BOCRA](<https://www.bocra.org.bw/sites/default/files/sites/default/files/documents/BOCRA2025_ANNUAL_REPORT_%28WEB%29_compressed.pdf>). It was set up in 2020. In the last twelve months, [the Botswana Computer Security Incident Response Team led the first National Cyber Drill in late February 2026](<http://www.bocra.org.bw/sites/default/files/sites/default/files/documents/BOCRA_Newsletter%2C_Issue_003_compressed.pdf>). [On 23 October 2026 the national CSIRT, through BOCRA, issued an urgent public advisory on the PHP2Shell flaws](<http://www.bocra.org.bw/node/62863>). It asked organisations to patch and to report compromise to it. No designation of critical information infrastructure has been found. Operating would need the country to designate its critical information infrastructure, or to bind the operators of critical systems to report incidents to the national body.

[A law of January 2024 created the Agence Nationale de la Cybersécurité, which appears in neither FY2026 budget volume](<http://www.finances.gouv.cf/sites/default/files/2026-03/Cadre%20des%20D%C3%A9penses%20%C3%A0%20Moyen%20Terme%202026.pdf>). The network-security line is FCFA 4,000,000 (proposed, 2026). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No incident handled or public alert issued by the national body has been found since October 2023. No designation of critical information infrastructure has been found, and no count of incidents handled. Establishing would need the national body to have handled a cyber incident or issued a public alert in the past three years.

[Decree 2024-958 of 30 October 2024 created ANSSI, the national information systems security agency](<https://artci.ci/en/cybersecurity-handover-of-responsibilities-between-artci-and-anssi/>). [It took over ARTCI's cybersecurity missions on 30 April 2025](<https://artci.ci/en/cybersecurity-handover-of-responsibilities-between-artci-and-anssi/>). [Companies must by law report cyber incidents to ANSSI, with administrative sanctions for failing to](<https://digitalmag.ci/cote-divoire-ne-pas-signaler-une-cyberattaque-expose-a-des-poursuites-penales-et-administratives/>). In the last twelve months, [ANSSI ran CYBER.EX 2026, the first national cyber crisis exercise, on 28 and 29 October 2026](<https://news.abidjan.net/articles/749802/la-cote-divoire-teste-sa-reponse-a-une-cyberattaque-lors-dun-premier-exercice-national>). [ANSSI states it recorded more than 12,100 cybercrime cases in 2024](<https://anssi.gouv.ci/panorama-des-menaces/>). No account of how it dealt with incidents in the past year has been found. Mature would need the national body to publish evidence of dealing with incidents, responding, containing or notifying and not only recording them, for a quarter or more ending within the past year.

[ANTIC, the national ICT agency, runs Cameroon's national Computer Incident Response Team](<https://www.ictacam.org/understanding-the-hidden-face-of-cybercrime-in-cameroon-a-deep-dive-into-the-numbers/>). In the last twelve months, [the team received new equipment worth over FCFA 735 million on 20 January 2026](<https://techafricanews.com/2026/01/21/cameroon-strengthens-cybersecurity-with-advanced-systems-at-national-cirt/>). [In March 2026 it went on site to a ransomware attack that took down half a public body's IT system](<https://www.cameroon-tribune.cm/article.html/81162/en.html/lutte-contre-la-cybercriminalite-la-riposte-nationale-s-organise>). [ANTIC says the law requires companies to report cybercrime to it](<https://www.digitalbusiness.africa/prosper-pagou-antic-en-2025-nous-avons-enregistre-17-500-plaintes-pour-un-prejudice-de-58-milliards-de-fcfa/>). No designation of critical information infrastructure has been found. Operating would need the country to designate its critical information infrastructure, or to bind the operators of critical systems to report incidents to the national body.

[Ordonnance n° 26/033 of 16 May 2026 tasks the Agence Nationale de Cybersécurité (ANCY) with setting up a national CERT](<https://fr.scribd.com/document/1057825809/J-O-n-special-du-16-juin-2026-ANCY>). [Article 4 requires public institutions and operators of vital importance to inform ANCY of all attacks and intrusions](<https://fr.scribd.com/document/1057825809/J-O-n-special-du-16-juin-2026-ANCY>). In the last twelve months, [the minister said in September 2026 that the agency had been created by presidential ordinance](<https://depeche.cd/2026/09/29/rdc-augustin-kibassa-detaille-les-avancees-dun-an-dans-la-transformation-numerique/>). No incident handled or public alert issued by the national body has been found since October 2023. Establishing would need the national body to have handled a cyber incident or issued a public alert in the past three years.

[ANSSI of the Republic of the Congo is stated to have signed the AAECA-Net accession charter in Tunis on 26 June 2026](<https://www.aicto.org/the-national-agency-for-information-systems-security-anssi-of-the-republic-of-the-congo-joins-the-arab-african-e-certification-and-digital-trust-services-network-aaeca-net/>). In the last twelve months, [ANSSI held a working session in Brazzaville on 28 July 2026](<https://fr.linkedin.com/posts/anssi-cg_il-sest-tenu-ce-mardi-28-juillet-2026-au-activity-7487929626313486337-A1oT>). It was to validate a draft qualification standard for cybersecurity audit providers. [In November 2026 the minister said no public service goes live without the agency's approval](<https://pp.itu.int/2026/en/itu_policy_statements/congo-rep-of-the/>). [A national SOC and CERT are planned for 2027](<https://pp.itu.int/2026/en/itu_policy_statements/congo-rep-of-the/>). No incident handled or public alert issued by the national body has been found since October 2023. Establishing would need the national body to have handled a cyber incident or issued a public alert in the past three years.

[In 2021 Law 21-012/AU made the national digital development agency (ANADEN), through its cybersecurity directorate, the competent national cybersecurity authority](<https://ancs.gouv.km/about/>). [It oversees the security of information systems, networks and trust services](<https://ancs.gouv.km/about/>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No incident handled or public alert issued by the national body has been found since October 2023. No designation of critical information infrastructure has been found, and no count of incidents handled. Establishing would need the national body to have handled a cyber incident or issued a public alert in the past three years.

[Ecofin Agency reports Cabo Verde launched a CSIRT within the State's Private Technological Network](<https://www.ecofinagency.com/news-digital/3110-50013-cape-verde-steps-up-cybersecurity-efforts-with-national-soc-incident-response-team>). It is described as a national cyber alert-and-response hub for public institutions and private organisations. [The record states the national SOC and CSIRT were launched on 30 October 2025](<https://www.mf.gov.cv/documents/198414/5793427/Lei%20que%20aprova%20o%20OE%202026.pdf>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No incident handled or public alert issued by the national body has been found since October 2023. Establishing would need the national body to have handled a cyber incident or issued a public alert in the past three years.

[The Minister Delegate for the Digital Economy said at the 3 September 2026 national AI forum that Djibouti has established a cyber security agency](<https://sonna.so/en/article/Somali-must-have-a-place-in-artificial-intelligence-Djibouti-minister-tells-first-national-forum>). The document gives no name for it. [The same minister said Djibouti has adopted a national cyber security strategy running from 2024 to 2029](<https://sonna.so/en/article/Somali-must-have-a-place-in-artificial-intelligence-Djibouti-minister-tells-first-national-forum>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No incident handled or public alert issued by the national body has been found since October 2023. Establishing would need the national body to have handled a cyber incident or issued a public alert in the past three years.

[In September 2026 a national cybersecurity strategy was in force, and the Information Systems Security Agency oversees its implementation](<https://www.echaab.dz/2026/09/20/%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B1%D9%82%D9%85%D9%86%D8%A9-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AC%D8%B2%D8%A7%D8%A6%D8%B1-%D8%B4%D9%81%D8%A7%D9%81%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D9%88%D8%B9%D8%B5%D8%B1%D9%86%D8%A9/>). [The Agency, part of the Ministry of National Defence, is stated to exist and operate under a Director General](<https://www.echoroukonline.com/ministry-of-defense-unveils-information-systems-security-strategy-until-2029>). It is stated to have run the strategy's launch, including text messages to citizens via all mobile operators. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No incident handled or public alert issued by the national body has been found since October 2023. Establishing would need the national body to have handled a cyber incident or issued a public alert in the past three years.

[An NTRA vice president and a deputy minister said in September 2026 that the National Cybersecurity Strategy 2023-2027 is being implemented](<https://www.technotime.net/17231>). He said Egypt established the Supreme Cybersecurity Council. He also said NTRA monitors cyber threats around the clock. In the last twelve months, [the Council was reported in November 2026 to have started work on a third edition of the strategy](<https://itmagazineme.com/egypt-allocates-440000-consultancy-budget-to-draft-national-data-centre-strategy/>). No incident handled or public alert issued by the national body has been found since October 2023. Establishing would need the national body to have handled a cyber incident or issued a public alert in the past three years.

No stage is set. No source found says whether Eritrea has adopted a cybersecurity strategy or created a national cyber body. None says it has neither. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found mentions an incident response team, a designation of critical information infrastructure or a count of incidents handled. Absent would need a source from the past three years that says Eritrea has no cybersecurity strategy and no national cyber body or response team.

[INSA's Director General said Ethio-CERT identified, responded to and reported more than 71,000 cyberattacks in the Ethiopian year 2018 E.C.](<https://techreviewafrica.com/news/7717>). [INSA said it thwarted more than 50,000 attacks in the first nine months of 2025/26](<https://addisfortune.news/news-alert/hackers-breach-shebamiles-not-its-miles-airline-says>). In the last twelve months, [Proclamation No. 1426/2026 identified 12 critical infrastructure sectors, including ICT, finance, transport, health and energy](<https://www.ena.et/web/eng/w/eng_9359494>). It requires owners and operators to meet 18 cybersecurity obligations. The latest dated fact is that [on 29 September 2026 INSA was stated to co-chair a newly established Financial Sector Cybersecurity Forum](<https://techreviewafrica.com/news/7510/ethiopia-establishes-financial-sector-cybersecurity-forum-to-improve-digital-resilience>), with the National Bank of Ethiopia.

[The ANINF (Agence nationale des infrastructures numériques et des fréquences) offers security-event analysis and forensics, Gabonreview reported in September 2026](<https://www.gabonreview.com/cybermenaces-ce-que-laninf-dit-vraiment-des-900-000-alertes-qui-font-polemique/>). Its support covers isolation and restoration. Public bodies are stated to have approached it for audits and investigations in recent months. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No incident handled or public alert issued by the national body has been found since October 2023. No designation of critical information infrastructure has been found. Establishing would need the national body to have handled a cyber incident or issued a public alert in the past three years.

[The communications minister said Ghana has 13 designated Critical Information Infrastructure sectors](<https://techafricanews.com/2026/10/08/ghana-strengthens-cyber-resilience-critical-infrastructure/>). About 200 institutions are identified as owners, and compliance is mandatory. In the last twelve months, [the Cyber Security Authority's CERT-GH responded to 3,363 cybersecurity incidents between January and June 2026, per the Communications Minister](<https://www.myjoyonline.com/cybersecurity-authority-responds-to-3363-incidents-in-six-months-sam-george/>). [The Authority presented counts of 4,938 incidents for January to September 2026 and 4,604 for the whole of 2025](<https://www.graphic.com.gh/news/general-news/ghana-news-ghana-records-ghc209m-in-cybercrime-losses-in-nine-months.html>). The latest dated fact is that [on 22 October 2026 the Authority and NITA issued a joint alert on two critical PHP vulnerabilities](<https://www.myjoyonline.com/csa-and-nita-order-government-institutions-to-fix-critical-php-vulnerabilities-within-seven-days/>).

[ANSSI Guinée, the national agency for information-system security and incident response, signed a performance contract with the digital economy ministry in July 2026](<https://investigatorguinee.com/2026/08/20/plateformes-gouvernementales-et-vulnerabilites-le-talon-dachille-de-la-transition-numerique-guineenne-par-dr-ibrahima-kalil-diakite/>). Its remit covers risk assessment, crisis management and incident response. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No incident handled or public alert issued by the national body has been found since October 2023. No designation of critical information infrastructure has been found. Establishing would need the national body to have handled a cyber incident or issued a public alert in the past three years.

[GmCSIRT, the Gambia Computer Security Incident Response Team, describes itself as the national CSIRT](<https://www.linkedin.com/posts/gmcsirt_cybersecurity-gmcsirt-pura-activity-7482750733738610688-ab_m>). It is a government agency founded in 2020, advising operators of critical information infrastructure. [The ministry's presentation lists a Gambia National Cybersecurity Strategy and policy for 2020-2026 among the country's existing policies and strategies](<https://publicadministration.desa.un.org/sites/default/files/list-of-files/2025/1.2.1%29%20data%20governance%20-mocde.pdf>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No incident handled or public alert issued by the national body has been found since October 2023. Establishing would need the national body to have handled a cyber incident or issued a public alert in the past three years.

[In September 2025 the Council of Ministers approved the National Cybersecurity Strategy of Guinea-Bissau at its ordinary meeting, ANG reports](<https://ang.gw/governo-aprova-diploma-de-conclusao-dos-estudos-do-ensino-secundario/>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No incident handled or public alert issued by a national body has been found since October 2023. No designation of critical information infrastructure has been found, and no duty on operators to report incidents. No count of incidents handled has been found. Establishing would need the national body to have handled a cyber incident or issued a public alert in the past three years.

[Article 21 of Ley 7/2024 of 23 December 2024 creates the National Agency for Cybersecurity and Critical Infrastructures (ANCIC)](<https://www.guineaecuatorialpress.com/noticias/ley_por_la_que_se_regula_el_uso_de_las_redes_sociales_los_delitos_informaticos_y_la_ciber_delincuencia>). It is an autonomous public body under the Presidency of the Government. Its functions are to manage cybersecurity through coordinated CERT/CSIRT teams, issue alerts on cyber incidents and respond to them. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No incident handled or public alert issued by the national body has been found since October 2023. Establishing would need the national body to have handled a cyber incident or issued a public alert in the past three years.

Kenya [promulgated regulations on critical information infrastructure in early 2024](<https://www.ca.go.ke/ca-lay-2500km-fibre-accross-19-counties>), says the Communications Authority's director general. [The National KE-CIRT/CC states it issued 20,748,489 cyber threat advisories in April-June 2026](<https://www.ca.go.ke/sites/default/files/2026-07/Cyber%20Security%20Report%20Q4%202025-2026_1.pdf>). In the last twelve months, [the centre and State House ICT restricted access to the defaced president.go.ke site to contain the attack detected on 18 July 2026](<https://itweb.africa/article/kenya-restores-presidential-website-after-cyber-attack/Gb3Bw7WadxLq2k6V>). [A National Cybersecurity Agency was set up under Legal Notice No. 89 of 2026, and its board was inaugurated on 2 November 2026](<https://www.kbc.co.ke/state-to-strengthen-cybersecurity-as-threats-surge-says-murkomen/>). The latest dated figure is that [for July to September 2026 the Authority counted about 2.6 billion threat events](<https://techmoran.com/2026/11/05/kenya-moves-to-operationalise-cybersecurity-agency-as-threats-hit-2-6-billion/>).

[The March 2026 National Data Governance Policy lists the National Cybersecurity Strategy among the policy instruments Liberia has adopted](<https://mopt.gov.lr/wp-content/uploads/2022/06/2026-Liberia-Data-Governance-Policy-REVISED-CIPESA-1.pdf>). [In October 2026 a senator cited the strategy as a step that strengthened Liberia's policy framework](<https://liberianinvestigator.com/senator-cyrus-urges-stronger-cybersecurity-protection-of-citizens-rights/>). Both sources have it running to 2029. In the last twelve months it was cited and not changed. The same policy [proposes a national CERT](<https://mopt.gov.lr/wp-content/uploads/2022/06/2026-Liberia-Data-Governance-Policy-REVISED-CIPESA-1.pdf>). No incident handled or public alert issued by a national body has been found since October 2023. Establishing would need the national body to have handled a cyber incident or issued a public alert in the past three years.

[On 20 September 2026 a meeting chaired by the minister of state discussed drawing up an integrated national cybersecurity plan](<https://lana.gov.ly/post.php?id=365878&lang=ar>). The head of the General Authority for Cybersecurity and Digital Sovereignty attended. So did the head of the National Authority for Information Security and Safety. Both are stated as existing national bodies. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No incident handled or public alert issued by a national body has been found since October 2023. Establishing would need the national body to have handled a cyber incident or issued a public alert in the past three years.

[In March 2023 an Oxford capacity review found Lesotho had no national cybersecurity strategy and no national CSIRT](<https://cybilportal.org/wp-content/uploads/2023/05/Lesotho-CMM-Report-2022-vFinal_31032023.pdf>). In the last twelve months, [by September 2026 the government had designated the Lesotho Communications Authority to host the national CSIRT](<https://lestimes.com/?p=91666>). This came ahead of the Cybersecurity Bill 2026. [In November 2026 the Authority said its LC-CSIRT now serves as the interim national CERT while a permanent body is prepared](<https://lestimes.com/?p=92104>). No incident handled or public alert issued by the national body has been found since October 2023. Establishing would need the national body to have handled a cyber incident or issued a public alert in the past three years.

[Decree 2-11-509 of 21 September 2011 created the DGSSI](<https://north-africa-middle-east-gulf.ec.europa.eu/document/download/4c8fe664-36fd-4721-81eb-5514bd6c0b96_en?filename=C_2026_5364_F1_COMMISSION_IMPLEMENTING_DECISION_FR_V2_P1_4911910.PDF>). [Of 879 attacks recorded in 2025, 109 needed direct intervention by its centre](<https://h24info.ma/maroc/dgssi-879-cyberattaques-recensees-en-2025/>). [Decree 2-15-712 of 2016 requires vital-importance infrastructures to declare incidents to the national centre](<https://www.ausimaroc.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/09/Conformite-avec-le-Decret-02-15-712-Apport-de-la-Norme-internationale-ISO-27001.pdf>), a white paper by the IT users' association AUSIM says. In the last twelve months, [a DGSSI study found these infrastructures' compliance above average](<https://lematin.ma/nation/cybersecurite-15-centres-de-surveillance-prevus-la-loi-en-revision/376014>). The latest dated fact is that [on 12 November 2026 the DGSSI issued a critical alert on attacks on ScreenConnect users](<https://lematin.ma/nation/cybersecurite-15-centres-de-surveillance-prevus-la-loi-en-revision/376014>).

[Madagascar's Computer Incident Response Team (CIRT) is stated to exist and operate, with a Director General, Eric Rakotomaniraka](<https://trendsnafrica.com/madagascar-nears-completion-of-sweeping-cybersecurity-reform-as-authorities-move-to-strengthen-national-cyber-resilience/>). He spoke for it at the inaugural Cybersecurity Symposium in Antananarivo on 22-23 June 2026. The CIRT is described as taking part in the December 2025 strategy launch workshop. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No incident handled or public alert issued by the national body has been found since October 2023. Establishing would need the national body to have handled a cyber incident or issued a public alert in the past three years.

[Decree No. 2026-0097/PT-RM of 25 February 2026 adopted the National Cybersecurity Strategy and its action plan for 2026-2030](<https://koulouba.ml/communique-du-conseil-des-ministres-du-mercredi-10-juin-2026-cm-n2026-23-sgg/>). In the last twelve months, [on 10 June 2026 the Council of Ministers adopted the texts creating ANSSI](<https://koulouba.ml/communique-du-conseil-des-ministres-du-mercredi-10-juin-2026-cm-n2026-23-sgg/>), the national information systems security agency. Then [Ordinance No. 2026-031 of 25 September 2026 created it](<https://beninwebtv.bj/mali-cnt-ratifie-creation-agence-cybersecurite-anssi-119-voix/>). [The transitional parliament ratified the ordinance on 19 November 2026](<https://beninwebtv.bj/mali-cnt-ratifie-creation-agence-cybersecurite-anssi-119-voix/>). No incident handled or public alert issued by the national body has been found since October 2023. Establishing would need the national body to have handled a cyber incident or issued a public alert in the past three years.

[Law 13/2026, in force from 29 September 2026, makes INTIC the National Cybersecurity Authority](<https://intic.gov.mz/mocambique-eleito-para-o-comite-de-gestao-da-anca-cert-em-representacao-da-africa-austral/>). [Critical information infrastructure operators must register with it and notify the national CSIRT of significant incidents, with fines for failing to](<https://www.incm.gov.mz/?sdm_process_download=1&download_id=5244>). In the last twelve months, [INTIC's chairman said the national CSIRT detected 5,654 ransomware infection attempts from January to July 2026](<https://jornalnoticias.co.mz/destaque/intic-na-campanha-contra-ransomware-nao-paguem-resgate-denunciem/>). [The Prosecutor-General said the national CSIRT logged 182,031 incidents in 2024](<https://aimnews.org/2025/04/29/mocambique-regista-centenas-de-burlas-de-pagamentos-eletronicos/>). No account of how the body dealt with incidents in the past year has been found. Mature would need the national body to publish evidence of dealing with incidents, responding, containing or notifying and not only recording them, for a quarter or more ending within the past year.
